properties.name: Single ISCO Occupation Coding
properties.description: Selects the highest-confidence occupation candidate above a threshold for each survey response and returns the response fields with the assigned ISCO code.

properties.name: isco_code_selector
properties.description: Assigns one ISCO code to each survey response by selecting the highest confidence candidate that meets the threshold. It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code.
